Marta Lambertini | Marta Lambertini (born 13 November 1937) is an Argentine composer.  She was born in San Isidro, Buenos Aires, and studied at the Universidad Catolica Argentina with Roberto Caamano, Luis Gianneo and Gerardo Gandini, graduating in 1972.  She continued her studies in electroacoustic music in Buenos Aires, at the Centro de Investigationes de la Ciudad with Francisco Kröpfl, Gerardo Gandini, José Maranzano and Gabriel Brncic.

The film was shot 1972 in Bogotá and Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia, and released 31 January 1974.  In 1973, the film music secured José Antonio Alcaraz and Rubén Fuentes the Silver Ariel for the best score (Ariel a Mejor Música de Fondo).
Ariel (DJ) | Ariel Belloso (born 14 September 1967) is an Argentine, UK Based DJ and record producer.  He began his career playing new wave music and disco music at clubs in Rosario and Buenos Aires during the early 1980s and moved to London in 1991, after spending 8 months in Ibiza, where he was influenced by the early house music and acid house sounds.
José Agustín Ramírez Altamirano | José Agustín Ramírez Altamirano (July 11, 1903 – September 12, 1957) was a Mexican composer.  Teacher, composer, poet and troubadour.  He was one of the great musical composers that contributed significantly to the musical heritage of Guerrero through songs that tell the beauty of the state and its people.
